title: Childhood Sexual Abuse and problem drinking in women: Neurobehavioral mechanisms
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings collected to investigate neurobehavioral mechanisms linking childhood sexual abuse and problem drinking in women. Data were collected from monozygotic twin pairs at Washington University School of Medicine to examine shared genetic and environmental influences on these behaviors. The dataset includes task-based EEG data along with stimulus materials and task instructions.
methods_description: Data collection took place at Washington University School of Medicine, St. Louis, under the supervision of Dr. Andrey Anokhin, approved by the Washington University Institutional Review Board. Participants were monozygotic twin pairs, identified by shared FamilyID in participants.tsv. Task description, subject instructions, task sequence files, and visual stimuli are provided in the stimuli folder.
